posts.title: Posts
posts.description: Publish and schedule photos, carousels, stories and reels on Facebook, Instagram and your WhatsApp status. The AI can write the caption and create automatic posts of your products.

connect.title: Accounts to publish to
connect.intro: Connect your business's Facebook page and its linked Instagram professional account.
connect.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect the page and its Instagram? Posts scheduled for Facebook or Instagram will fail until you connect again.
connect.notAvailable: Connecting Facebook and Instagram isn't enabled in Whasalia yet. Meanwhile you can use WhatsApp status.
connect.noInstagram: This page has no linked Instagram professional account. Link it in the Facebook page settings and reconnect.
connect.accountError: Meta refused access: reconnect the account.
connect.pickHint: Your user manages several pages. Choose the business's; its Instagram is connected too.

error.denied: You cancelled the permission on Facebook.
error.forbidden: Only a business admin can connect accounts.
error.not_configured: Connecting Facebook and Instagram isn't enabled in Whasalia yet.
error.exchange: Meta didn't complete the connection. Try again.
error.no_pages: We found no Facebook pages. Make sure you pick the business page when granting permission.

posts.emptyHint: Create a post or turn on automatic posts in “Automatic & settings”.

formatHint.post: 1 photo, a carousel of up to 10, or a video.
formatHint.story: 1 vertical photo or video. Lasts 24 hours.

actions.deleteConfirm: Delete this post? What's already published on the networks isn't removed.
actions.cancelConfirm: Cancel this post? It won't be published.

editor.noProducts: No active products with a photo.
editor.mediaHint: JPG, PNG or WebP; MP4 videos up to 100 MB. Photos are converted to JPG for Instagram automatically.
editor.caption: Caption
editor.aiIdea: What do you want to say? (optional if you picked a product)
editor.aiIdeaPlaceholder: E.g.: 2-for-1 this weekend, free shipping over $50…
editor.aiNeedsInput: Pick a product or write the idea.
editor.linkHint: On Facebook it's added at the end of the caption. Links aren't clickable on Instagram: write “link in bio”. If you pick a product and your store is published, the product link is used.
editor.timeNote: Your device's time. Whasalia checks every 5 minutes, so it may go out up to 5 minutes later.
editor.statusNote: Meta doesn't allow posting statuses through the API: Whasalia sends you the photo or video with the caption on WhatsApp so you can forward it to your status.

issues.media_required: Add at least one photo or video.
issues.one_media: Stories and reels take a single file.
issues.schedule_far: That date is too far ahead.

errors.no_credits: You're out of AI tokens. Top up in Billing.
errors.no_provider: The AI isn't available right now.
errors.not_editable: This post already went out and can't be edited.

toasts.captionReady: Caption ready. Review it before publishing.

reason.auth: Meta refused access: reconnect the account
reason.no_status_phones: no numbers for the status (Automatic & settings)
reason.no_conversation: couldn't open the chat with your number
reason.template_missing: the “Status ready to post” template is missing
reason.template_pending: the “Status ready to post” template is in review or not sent to Meta
reason.template_rejected: Meta rejected the “Status ready to post” template
reason.instagram_video_slow: Instagram took too long to process the video
reason.instagram_media_error: Instagram didn't accept the file (check format and size)
reason.instagram_media_expired: the file expired on Instagram; retry
reason.media_required: the photo or video is missing

settings.approvalHint: What Whasalia creates on its own (new product, restock and calendar) waits “To approve” and we let you know, or goes out at its time.
settings.autoNewHint: Posts the new product with its photo 30 minutes after it's created.
settings.autoRestock: When a sold-out product is back in stock
settings.autoRestockHint: At most once a day per product.
settings.calendarHint: Pick days and times. A day before, Whasalia picks the product you haven't posted for the longest and the AI writes the caption (1 token per post; without tokens it uses a simple caption).
settings.noSlots: Add at least one day and time.
settings.statusHint: Meta doesn't allow posting WhatsApp statuses through the API. At the post's time, Whasalia sends the photo or video with the caption to these numbers, from your WhatsApp, with a link to share it straight to your status.
settings.statusPhones: Numbers that get the content (with country code)
settings.statusOwnNumber: Use a number other than your WhatsApp Business one (e.g. your personal phone), and say “Hi” to your business from it now and then: that way it's sent instantly without a template.
settings.instructionsPlaceholder: E.g.: casual tone, mention free delivery downtown, use #ShopLocal…

template.title: “Status ready to post” template
template.draft: Used when more than 24 h passed since your number wrote to the business. Send it to Meta for approval.
template.pending: In Meta's review. It usually takes minutes to a few hours.
template.rejected: Meta rejected it: {reason}. Edit it and send it again.
template.noWhatsApp: Connect a WhatsApp number to send it.

statusPage.title: For your WhatsApp status
statusPage.intro: {business}'s post. Share it to your status:
statusPage.steps: Tap “Share on WhatsApp” and choose “My status”. If your phone doesn't allow it, download the file, copy the caption and post it from WhatsApp's Updates tab.
statusPage.notFound: This post is no longer available.

admin.title: Meta: Posts (second app)
admin.subtitle: Meta app only for publishing to Facebook and Instagram (pages_manage_posts, instagram_content_publish…). Its review is separate from messaging's.
admin.configId: Facebook Login for Business configuration ID (optional)
admin.configHelp: Without a configuration these permissions are requested:
admin.redirectHelp: Paste it in the app: Facebook Login for Business → Settings.
admin.removeConfirm: Remove the posts app? Businesses won't be able to connect new accounts.
